**Job Description

****Are you our new People Operations Specialist? Consider these questions:

**

• Would you like to be part of a small “People” team in Copenhagen, contributing to a large international organization with ambitious growth plans, having colleagues in Germany (Hamburg), China, Singapore, and USA?

• Do you have deep experience in Danish payroll and time administration, paired with an eye for detail and a pride in upholding compliance, confidentiality, and integrity?

• Do you have a strong service mindset and the courage to challenge the status quo?

If you can answer ‘Yes’ to these questions, perhaps you are the right person to join our local People team in Copenhagen.

We are always ready and willing to help each other and our colleagues with any HR-related topics and we expect you to be ready to do the same!

****What the job is …

****For our team in Copenhagen, we are looking for a trusted expert and focal point for all payroll and time-management operations for Satair Copenhagen. In this role, you will ensure seamless monthly data coordination with our third-party payroll provider and handle the daily administration of our time-registration tools.

You will drive operational efficiency by managing end-to-end employee lifecycle data within our HR IT systems, act as the local HR procurement delegate, and provide high-quality, reliable ad-hoc support to employees, managers, and HR colleagues - safeguarding compliance and precision at every step.

**These Are The Most Important Tasks In The Role

**

• Payroll & Time Expert: Act as the expert and sole focal point for all payroll and time-management-related tasks for Satair Copenhagen, holding overall responsibility for monthly inputs to our third-party payroll provider.

• Time Administration: Take responsibility for the day-to-day administration of our time-registration tool.

• Lifecycle Coordination: Coordinate the on- and offboarding of employees in our HR IT systems.

• HR Procurement Delegate: Act as the procurement delegate for the local HR function, creating purchase orders and vendors in SAP, approving invoices, etc.

• Mobility & Recruitment Support: Liaise with external providers on international mobilities, visa, and work permit matters, while supporting the team with various recruitment administrative tasks.

• Process Optimization: Contribute to process improvement and optimization initiatives, bringing your ideas to the table as our in-house expert on payroll and time administration.

• Ad Hoc Support: Provide high-quality, reliable ad-hoc support to employees, managers, and HR colleagues.

Together with your colleagues in the Copenhagen team, you will ensure that the organization is provided with the best and most professional support and a positive experience when they drop into our office or reach out to us.

****How you will contribute to the team

****Your educational background is within HR or general administration, which equipped you for roles with HR operational tasks, complex payroll workflows, and system administration.

**Your Professional Skills Include

**

• Danish Payroll Preparation Expertise: Strong experience in Danish Payroll, including a solid understanding of legal and tax requirements. You are comfortable advising employees on working time directives, holidays, flex-time accounts, paternity/maternity leaves, and basic taxation rules.

• Provider Experience: Experience working closely with an external payroll provider (e.g., Azets).

• HR Tech & Systems: Experience working across different HR tools, with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with Google Workspace is a plus.

• Data Protection: A natural habit of applying the fundamentals of data privacy and data protection principles to your work on a daily basis.

**Your Personal & Interpersonal Skills

**

• Preferably, you have experience from an international environment. Most importantly, you are fluent in English (our corporate language). Danish language skills are a plus.

• It is very important that you are eager to learn, proactive when a new topic arises, and have the courage to challenge the status quo.

• As you will be working with a variety of complex tasks, it is crucial that working in a structured manner comes naturally to you, alongside high attention to detail, strong reliability, integrity, and a strict focus on deliveries.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your CV and application as soon as possible in order to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Job Description

**Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

**Responsibilities & Technologies

**In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

**About You

**You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

_Most machine learning never makes it to production. Your job is to make sure ours does. We are looking for an ML Engineer who turns models into reliable, maintained systems that construction companies actually use to make better decisions about their equipment and operations. You will work at the intersection of data science and software engineering, shaping how machine learning gets built, deployed, and improved at Trackunit.

_**What’s in it for you?

**Bring machine learning into everyday use. Turn models and experiments into reliable products that help customers make better decisions about their equipment and operations.

Shape how we build and run ML. Influence the tools, engineering practices, and deployment patterns that take solutions from an initial idea through to production and continuous improvement.

Work on interesting data challenges. Explore how equipment, sensor, and contextual data can support useful predictions and insights for the construction industry.

Build alongside people with different strengths. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and product teams, combining scientific thinking with practical software engineering and customer understanding.

Develop your craft and your career. Join an international environment with knowledge sharing, feedback, and support for your personal and professional development.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• You have MLOps experience taking machine learning solutions into production and maintaining them beyond their initial release.

• You bring strong Python skills and solid software engineering practices, including testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD.

• Databricks expertise is a significant advantage.

• You ideally bring strong hands-on experience building ML workflows in Databricks, tracking experiments and managing models with MLflow, and deploying and monitoring models in production.

• You understand the ML lifecycle, from feature preparation and reproducible training to evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

• You can work with data scientists to assess model performance, recognise issues such as data leakage and drift, and translate experimental code into maintainable systems.

• You have experience with cloud platforms and tools for orchestrating ML workflows and serving predictions. You can make sensible trade-offs between reliability, performance, and cost.

• You enjoy shaping solutions with others, explaining technical choices clearly, and connecting engineering decisions to customer needs.

• Experience training, tuning, and validating machine learning or deep learning models would be a plus.

• Experience with time series, sensor or geospatial data, or distributed processing would be a plus.

You don’t need experience with every tool or data type listed. If you bring strong engineering skills and enjoy making machine learning useful in practice, we’d like to hear from you.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**About The Job

**Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and help strengthen the bank’s privileged access management capabilities. You will be responsible for implementing, operating, and continuously improving PAM controls that protect privileged accounts, administrative access, and critical systems across Saxo’s technology landscape.

Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams, you will help reduce privileged access risk through modern PAM practices, automation, and Zero Trust principles.

**Responsibilities

**

• Implement and manage privileged access controls across on-premises and cloud environments

• Administer PAM capabilities including credential vaulting, password rotation, session management, and privileged session recording

• Onboard privileged accounts, systems, applications, and service accounts into the PAM platform

• Support adoption of least-privilege, Just-In-Time (JIT), and Zero Trust access models

• Automate PAM processes and integrations using PowerShell and APIs

• Support monitoring, reporting, audits, and access to governance activities

**Your profile

**You are an experienced cybersecurity professional with a strong background in Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and security engineering. You combine deep technical expertise with a practical, risk-based approach to securing critical systems and privileged access within complex enterprise environments.

• 7-10 years of experience in Privileged Access Management, Identity & Access Management, or Cyber Security Engineering

• Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM solutions

• Strong understanding of privileged access risks, account lifecycle management, and security best practices

• Experience securing Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, databases, and network devices

• Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Azure environments

• Experience with automation and scripting, including PowerShell and APIs

• Experience working in regulated environments, preferably within financial services

Certifications & Platforms

You have practical experience working with leading PAM technologies and understand how privileged access controls support a broader security strategy. Experience with multiple platforms is highly valued, particularly in enterprise-scale environments.

• Experience with Delinea Secret Server or other Delinea PAM solutions will be considered a strong advantage

• Experience with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, One Identity, or similar PAM platforms is also highly valued

**Personal competencies

**You are a structured and proactive professional who thrives on solving complex security challenges. You can effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders and translate business and security requirements into practical solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities

• Structured, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset

• Ability to translate security requirements into practical technical solutions

• Strong collaboration skills and a continuous improvement mindset

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Process Owner, Order to Cash to be based in Denmark

In this role, you will own Ambu’s global end-to-end Order to Cash process within our ERP transformation, covering sales planning, order management, distribution, invoicing, customer service and collections. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with dual reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Transformation, and work closely with Global Business Owners, other Global Process Owners, Commercial, IT, Finance, Quality and site leadership.

This is a unique opportunity to create a globally aligned Order to Cash capability and set the standard for how it operates across Ambu. It will suit an experienced leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to deliver transformation at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Owning the global Order to Cash process vision, standards, governance and roadmap

• Acting as Business Workstream Lead and driving fit-to-standard design

• Leading process decisions that balance service, cash, compliance and customer experience

• Establishing process KPIs and driving readiness and adoption across countries

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have 10+ years of experience in supply chain, operations or business transformation, from industry or consulting

• Have deep expertise across the complete Order to Cash value stream

• Are comfortable working across time zones and travelling across Ambu’s global footprint

• Have experience from a regulated environment, ideally medical devices, life sciences or pharmaceuticals

• Have led large-scale ERP-enabled transformations or Order to Cash workstreams

• Are structured, proactive and outcome-oriented, with strong stakeholder management skills

• Have SAP S/4HANA, Infor, Oracle Cloud or similar experience and strong written and spoken English

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Lead customer software implementation from onboarding to go-live

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for a Project Lead, Customer Enablement & Governance who will establish and lead our customer software implementation capability. You will own customer onboarding from project initiation through go-live and initial hypercare support, ensuring a structured and frictionless experience for new customers.

You will be part of Customer Enablement and Governance and act as the primary program interface between customers and UNEEG. The role coordinates commercial, technical, clinical, legal/data privacy, cybersecurity and quality stakeholders, while the relevant specialists remain accountable for their evidence and decisions. You will work closely together with colleagues across the entire organization.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Lead customer onboarding and implementation plans, including milestones, risks, decisions and escalations

• Coordinate hospital software, legal, data privacy, security and technical review processes and route specialist questions to the relevant subject-matter owners

• Drive infrastructure readiness, installation, validation, go-live and hypercare activities

• Maintain implementation playbooks, templates, status reporting, evidence requests and knowledge repositories

• Coordinate operational handover to support and drive continuous improvement through implementation KPIs and lessons learned

• Create scalable software implementation processes that support growth in our focus markets

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are customer-focused, collaborative and pragmatic, with the ability to build trust across technical and non-technical groups

• Create structure and momentum without waiting for perfect processes

• Are highly structured, accountable and proactive, with strong planning, documentation and follow-through

• Are comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities and leading through influence

• Can balance customer requirements, patient impact, compliance and internal priorities without cutting corners

• Have sound judgement and a hands-on, solution-oriented mindset

**Your background:

**

• A bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, computer science, health technology, life sciences, business, project management or a related discipline

• At least 3 years of program or project management experience in customer-facing software implementations

• Experience from healthcare technology, SaaS, enterprise software or medical devices

• Proven cross-functional stakeholder leadership and confident customer communication

• Experience managing multiple complex implementations in an evolving environment

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken, and willingness to travel

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• Hospital IT deployment, clinical engineering or digital health implementation

• Regulated software, validation and medical device quality systems

• Privacy, cybersecurity and assurance reviews, including GDPR, HIPAA, DPIA, HECVAT, SIG, MDS2, DTAC or DSPT

• Relevant standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISO 13485 or IEC 81001-5-1

• Healthcare systems in both the US and Europe

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in building a scalable customer implementation capability in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact VP Commercial, Kristian Lykke Fick, at +45 53 39 80 18.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

jobs.occupation: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark?
jobs.description:
Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark?

Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

• Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).

• New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).

• New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.

• Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.

• A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.

Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

• Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.

• Value a strong professional network across hospitals.

• Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.

• Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.

• Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.

• On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).

About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

• The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.

• Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc positions ‘Hybrid War and Democracy’ at The Danish Institute for Advanced Study DIAS
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) at the University of Southern Denmark, Odense, invites applications for one or more full-time Postdoc positions.

The ’Hybrid War and Democracy’ initiative explores changes in how international conflicts are waged. Domestic and foreign influence campaigns are bolstered by new digital technologies and artificial intelligence. This creates new challenges for democracies, threat perceptions, information integrity, and for citizens’ information agency.

The postdoc positions will be part of a broader initiative understanding these new dynamics. 

Employment is expected to begin on April 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, and will be for a period of up to two years. The place of employment will be Odense.

Research profiles and tasks

We are looking for a candidate with a background in computational social sciences, data science, including (but not limited to) computer science, communication, political science, linguistics, information studies, digital humanities, sociology or psychology. 

An ideal candidate would have a strong interest in the topic and bring methodological skills to conduct cutting edge work in this space. The Postdoc(s) will be embedded in an interdisciplinary project team and collaborate closely with other scholars at DIAS and the Centre for Digital Democracy.

Candidates must have a research profile grounded in the use of computational methods to answer social science questions. Research within this project will primarily involve using quantitative and computational techniques as well as surveys and/ or experiments.

Expectations and key responsibilities

The Postdoc(s) will be involved in all aspects of the research, from conception, execution, analysis, publishing, and public dissemination. A strong background in computational techniques is necessary, and experience the topic would be ideal.

Candidates are expected to be willing and able to contribute to DIAS and DDC by producing original research of high international quality, engaging in information exchange with both academic and non-academic actors (e.g., journalists, the public, and policy makers), contributing to grant acquisition efforts, and translating technical details across different disciplines.

Candidates are expected to:

• 
Be capable of working independently and on a team through the research process, including with regards to data collection, data analysis, writing scientific articles, and knowledge dissemination.

• 
Be able to translate methodological specifics to non-computational researchers

• 
Contribute both academically and socially to the research environment at DIAS and the DDC

• 
Code proficiently in R or Python.

• 
Be able to communicate project results in English both in writing in academic contexts and to the broader public (Danish would be an advantage but not required)

• 
Present research results at international conferences in social science or computational disciplines

• 
Possibly contribute to teaching programs (in consultation with relevant departments)

• 
Work and be present in Odense

Inquiries about the project and the positions can be addressed to Prof. Claes de Vreese (chv@sam.sdu.dk). 

About The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

About the DDC

The DDC is a part of the Faculty of Business and Social Sciences. It is an interdisciplinary Centre with members from computer science, law, media studies, political science, business, and organizations. The DDC believes in fostering a stimulating and inspiring environment for both faculty members and students. The DDC’s ambition is to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both research, education, and impact. Furthermore, the DDC wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family. Additional information about working in Denmark can be found at Work in Denmark.

Application and assessment process

Appointment to the position requires a PhD degree or equivalent and will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the Danish state with the associated circular on the protocol on job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for the position of postdocs as described herein.

An application must include:

• 
A cover letter stating your specific interest and qualifications for the project in question (max two pages). It is strongly encouraged that you include a github link or proof of coding proficiency. 

• 
Detailed CV, including personal contact information and date entries

• 
Copies of certificates and diplomas (BSc, MSc, and PhD degrees)

• 
The names and complete contact details (including phone numbers and email addresses) of at least two references

• 
A complete list of publications indicating which publications are most relevant for the position

• 
The 3 most relevant publications or unpublished chapters of the PhD thesis. 
NOTE: If publications have been co-authored, co-author statements must be included and contain information like in this example. The statement is just for your inspiration

• 
A teaching portfolio as documentation for teaching experience (if applicable).

 All non-Danish documents must be translated into English.

Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

Applications that are incomplete may be rejected without any substantive evaluation.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an academic assessment committee that determines whether applicants are qualified to be a postdoctoral fellow. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. The committee reserves the right to arrive at a decision solely based on the material submitted.

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. As part of the assessment, a short coding test may be held.

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The assessment report will subsequently be forwarded to the Head of Department who will assemble an appointment committee. The appointment committee will manage and complete a series of job interviews with especially promising applicants. On the basis of the applications, the written assessments, the job interviews, and a deliberation within the appointment committee, the head of department determines which candidate(s) will be offered the position.

We recommend reading "How to apply for a position at SDU" before applying.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now" on our website.

Uploaded files must be in Adobe PDF (unlocked). The application and CV must each not exceed 10 MB in file size.

 

Application deadline: November 23, 2026, 23:59 CET/CEST.

 

Applicants may also wish to consider the related DIAS Fellow position in Hybrid War and Democratic Challenges. Candidates interested in both positions must submit a separate application for each position, as appointment to a position is only possible if an application has been submitted for that specific vacancy.

 

Salary and employment terms

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Qualifications

Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of computational social sciences, data science, including (but not limited to) computer science, communication, political science, linguistics, information studies, digital humanities, sociology or psychology. 

• 
To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained (or approved to defend) a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline.

Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries.

Be fluent in English.

Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. Additional information

For more questions about the position please contact Prof Claes de Vreese via email (chv@sam.sdu.dk).

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at the DDC and DIAS in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For further information, please see SDU’s pages on salary, taxation, and general employment conditions.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Danish Tenure Track Programme

An appointment as Assistant Professor (Danish tenure track) is limited to a six-year term. The academic assessment for promotion to Associate Professor must be initiated no later than the end of the fifth year of employment. However, a tenure track assistant professor may request an earlier assessment within the first four years.

If the initial assessment is negative, one reassessment may be conducted during the final six months prior to a potential transition. A maximum of two assessments may be undertaken.

A positive assessment leads to appointment to a permanent Associate Professor position. If the final assessment is negative, the employment may be terminated in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

A six-year development plan for the tenure track programme is established at the start of employment.

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

• 
Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

• 
Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

• 
An elaborated research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

• 
Copies of certificates/Diplomas (Master and PhD degree).

• 
Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

• 
Up to 3 of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload one PDF file for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

• 
Applicants are requested to submit a teaching portfolio with the application as documentation for teaching experience as well as supervision qualifications. Formal application instructions and a guide for the teaching portfolio can be found here.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Submission guidelines

• 
Files must be submitted in PDF format.

• 
If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

• 
Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

• 
Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the assessment process and references may be obtained. 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.

Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now" on our website.

We recommend reading "How to apply for a position at SDU" before applying.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

 

Application deadline: November 23, 2026, 23:59 CET/CEST.

The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Nano Optics (www.sdu.dk/nano-optics) invites applications for an Associate Professor position in ‘Experimental Nano-Optics’. The starting date is Feb 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The successful candidate is expected to conduct cutting-edge experimental research within nano-optics involving advanced optical characterization of localized and propagating strongly enhanced and confined electromagnetic excitations with the state-of-the-art amplitude and phase-resolved near-field microscope available (NeaSpec). The near-field characterization is expected to be complemented with other optical characterization techniques as well as with performing advanced electromagnetic modelling. The candidate should have documented teaching experience at both BSc and MSc levels along with the corresponding teaching portfolio.

The application material should include a detailed motivation and an outline of the research activities that are to be pursued. In their applications, applicants should highlight their ten most significant journal publications, detailing also their author contributions. Applicants who wish to be considered should provide a link to a fully-updated ResearcherID (www.researcherid.com). The application material should also include detailed accounts on supervision and teaching experience.

The prospective candidates should have a Ph.D. degree in physics, preferably within nano-optics, and documented research experience in the aforementioned experimental techniques. They are expected to have a notable international profile, strong record of research publications, and demonstrated exceptional potential to excel in scientific research. We expect the candidate to actively engage in the development of academic research, conducting vigorous fund raising activities, and educational environment at the Centre for Nano Optics.

The candidate is expected to teach and instruct both graduate and undergraduet students as well as supervise bachelor and master projects. Furthermore, the candicate is expected to contribute actively to young-researcher education through supervision of Ph.D. students and postdoctorial researchers. 

For further information about the position and research infrastructure as well as Centre for Nano Optics, contact Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Read more on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

Contact information
For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci. 

Further information about this position is available Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Please be aware that we will not accept any email applications, as all applications must be submitted through the SDU online recruitment system.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Research plan for the position in question (max. 2 pages). 
Upload in the field called "Project description". 

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, external funding etc.

• 
Verified copies of official Certificates/Diplomas (BSc, MSc and PhD) 

• 
List of publications with most relevant publications highlighted.

• 
Up to three names and emails of researchers, who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is November 1st, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Read more and apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

jobs.occupation: Position as a doctoral candidate (PhD student) at Department of Clinical Physiology and Nuclear Medicine within Centre of Diagnostic Investigations, Rigshospitalet Copenhagen University Hospital.
jobs.description:
This is a 3-year full-time PhD position with enrollment in the PhD program at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. The successful candidate will contribute to research that seeks to improve the quality, accuracy, and clinical utility of positron emission tomography (PET) imaging using artificial intelligence (AI). Specifically, the PhD project will focus on developing and validating PET emission-derived AI-based attenuation correction methods that enable artifact-free, time-matched attenuation estimates and support ultra-low-dose PET imaging and improved quantitative analysis.

Tasks include:

• You will work at Rigshospitalet, Department of Nuclear Medicine

• You will join the DEPICT AI and image analysis section, and work with our group of computer scientists, engineers, physicists and medical doctors.

• You will join Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network PREFERENCE, including international mentoring and exposure to both academic and industrial research environments.

• You will work with advanced AI models to address PET quantification related to motion artifacts and attenuation correction.

• One-month secondments are planned with University of Bern to work on integration into AI-based reconstruction and with University of Amsterdam to work on repeatability studies with different tracers. A secondment at Siemens Healthineers, Knoxville is planned for reconstruction integration.

Qualifications:

• A master’s degree in computer science, physics, biomedical engineering or equivalent

• Ability to work independently

• "Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English"

• Good programming skills; Python experience is a plus

• Experience with AI development with focus on deep learning and images

• Strong collaboration skills

• Knowledge of medical image data will be an advantage

• Willingness to travel and flexibility

What We Offer

We provide an opportunity to be part of an ambitious research group within a clinical department with focus on state-of-the-art PET/CT scanners utilizing the new and emerging lines of long axial field-of-view (LAFOV) PET/CT’s. The PhD project is fully funded under the EU Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network program, and you will be part of a network of doctoral students working towards developing innovative LAFOV PET/CT image analysis tools and performing groundbreaking clinical LAFOV PET/CT research. You will have a strong supervisor group with both technical and medical background.

The position will be in our new facilities at our AI section, DEPICT, at Rigshospitalet, and you will be referring to Professor Flemming Littrup Andersen at Department of Nuclear Medicine.

General Eligibility Criteria

Mobility Rule: The fellow may not have resided in Denmark, where the research training activities take place, for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the recruitment date (and may not have carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark).

Early-Stage Researcher: The fellow must be — at the date of recruitment — an ‘early stage researcher’ (i.e. in the first four years (full-time equivalent) of his/her research career and not have a doctoral degree).

Application Process

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, and applications should be submitted online via the job advert link. Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV and a motivated application, detailing relevant coursework, previous research experience, education and practical skills.

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, or ethnicity.

Terms of Employment

The position is full-time for a period of three years and is available from November 1, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement within the Capital Region of Denmark. Salary will be negotiated according to the collective agreement for academic personal, see link.

Further information:

PREFERENCE.

Rigshospitalet.

DEPICT.

Project contact: Flemming Littrup Andersen, Clinical Professor, Department of Clinical physiology and Nuclear Medicine.  For further inquiries, please contact Flemming Littrup Andersen (flemming.andersen@regionh.dk) or Claes N. Ladefoged (claes.noehr.ladefoged@regionh.dk)

About Centre of Diagnostic investigation, Rigshospitalet

The Centre of Diagnostic Investigation comprises a collection of highly specialized departments, including Diagnostic Radiology, Clinical Biochemistry, Pathology, Clinical Immunology, Clinical Physiology and Nuclear Medicine, Clinical Microbiology, and Clinical Genetics & Centre of Genomic Medicine.

The centre has approximately 1.550 staff members and an annual turnover of DKK 1.2 billion. Each year, the centre performs approximately 10 million laboratory analyses and 650.000 imaging examinations, based on 1 million contacts with patients and donors.

The centre’s core activities include high-level research, strong educational environments, specialized diagnostics and patient treatment. Its 36 professors and other researchers publish more than 700 scientific articles annually in international journals.
